for i in range(len(sol)-1):
    a, b = sol[i], sol[i+1]
    ra, ca = divmod(a, 5)
    rb, cb = divmod(b, 5)
    dr = abs(ra - rb)
    dc = abs(ca - cb)
    valid = (dr == 2 and dc == 1) or (dr == 1 and dc == 2)
    if not valid:
        print(f"INVALID MOVE at step {i}: {a} -> {b}, dr={dr}, dc={dc}")
    else:
